controls.title: Identify vulnerabilities across the asset estate
controls.statement: Keep vulnerability scanning coverage aligned with the asset inventory. Use current detection information and investigate uncovered assets and scan failures.
controls.risk: Unknown weaknesses on overlooked systems could give an attacker an entry point into business services.
controls.scope: Internal and externally exposed assets, applications and vulnerability detection tools.
controls.examine: Reconcile discovered assets with scan targets, completed scans, authentication success and scanner update records.
controls.interview: Ask the scanning owner how new assets, failed scans and systems that cannot be scanned are handled.
controls.test: Sample assets from the inventory and trace them to recent usable scan results. Verify scanner currency and the required scan types and frequencies.
test_steps: Select assets from authoritative inventories across network, endpoint, cloud, application and externally exposed environments and trace each to a recent scan or assessment.
Verify authenticated coverage where supported, scanner and signature currency, required frequency and successful access to the intended components.
Introduce or identify a known safe test weakness in a controlled asset and confirm detection, correct asset attribution, severity context and ticket creation.
Compare scan targets back to inventory and investigate blind spots, failed credentials, excluded assets and results older than the defined interval.
controls.expected: Coverage gaps and failures are identified and followed up; detection information, scanning methods and frequency meet applicable requirements.

mappings.basis: Requires automated asset discovery at least fortnightly; confirm discovery method and cadence.
Requires a scanner with an up-to-date vulnerability database.
Requires internal automated scans at least quarterly, both authenticated and unauthenticated, with a SCAP-compliant tool.
Requires external automated scans at least monthly with a SCAP-compliant tool.
Addresses discovery and scanning; the source also covers analysis, remediation and sharing information.

controls.title: Remediate and verify software weaknesses
controls.statement: Assign detected weaknesses for treatment, apply fixes or approved mitigations within applicable deadlines, and verify that the weakness has been addressed.
controls.risk: Known software weaknesses left unresolved could let attackers steal information or interrupt important services.
controls.scope: Software and firmware weaknesses, responsible owners, remediation deadlines and exceptions.
controls.examine: Review vulnerability findings, vendor release dates, treatment decisions, patch deployments and verification results.
controls.interview: Ask owners how urgency is determined, changes are tested and overdue or unsupported systems are handled.
controls.test: Sample findings across exposure and severity levels. Compare release or discovery dates with the applicable deadline, and confirm installed fixes or successful retests rather than relying only on closed tickets.
test_steps: Select vulnerabilities across severity, exposure, asset criticality, exploitability, age and exception status, including items marked remediated.
Recalculate the applicable priority and due date from policy and compare it with discovery, assignment, mitigation, exception and escalation records.
Inspect the live asset for the installed fix or compensating control and repeat the relevant scan or safe exploit check rather than relying on ticket closure.
Confirm overdue and failed remediation is escalated, accepted exceptions have authority and expiry, and successful retests update risk and reporting.
controls.expected: The treatment is verified and timely; exceptions have documented justification and follow-up, with each source-specific deadline assessed.

mappings.basis: For the stated online-service scenario, non-critical vendor findings without working exploits must be treated within two weeks of release.
Requires automated operating-system updates at least monthly; verify automation and schedule.
Requires automated application updates at least monthly; verify automation and schedule.
Requires vulnerability remediation through processes and tooling at least monthly.
Also requires pre-installation testing for side effects and integration with configuration management.
